reference_scope: Numeric domains reviewed against the UDS v3 RDD and Genetic RDD. TA subset version and preprocessing remain unknown. Reference incompatibility is not proof of source-record error.
moca_policy_authority: Explicit user selection in this chat on 2026-10-31.
outlier_policy: Tukey 1.5 IQR flags only; no deletion or winsorization.

NACCFADM.note: Code 0 combines no with unknown; true missingness is not recoverable from that code.

NACCFFTD.note: Code 0 combines no with unknown; true missingness is not recoverable from that code.

NACCBMI.note: The table lists 888.8 while the derivation text uses 888; neither is a substantive BMI. The latter remains explicitly ambiguous.

measurements.scope: Mechanical usability check, not an imaging-QC certification. Nonpositive unselected measurements are flagged, not used to exclude an entire person.

selected.formula: (left + right) / 2; both inputs must be numerically usable
selected.complete_case_scope: Eligibility for paired outputs or future common model sample only; no global deletion from univariate summaries.
